Native Android chess engine

The Android APK includes the unmodified official Stockfish 19 ARM64 universal Android executable for compatible Android 10+ 64-bit ARM devices. It is distributed under GNU GPLv3. The corresponding complete source at the exact upstream commit is available from the Stockfish project. The APK includes the full GPLv3 license text and source provenance in its third-party notices. The build verifies the official binary archive against its pinned SHA-256 digest before packaging.

Official binary: Stockfish 19 ARM64 universal Android release. Source commit: edb0d9db6731067ec50ce619ff372b463bc4dd5d.

The full Stockfish license text is also included in the APK and available in the project's license file. See the complete third-party notice for binary provenance and the pinned digest.

Chess engine and rules

Stockfish.js 19.0.1 is distributed under GNU GPLv3. Its JavaScript and WebAssembly assets are checked against pinned SHA-256 digests before execution. Chess rules and move validation are provided by chess.js 1.4.0 under the BSD 2-Clause License and copied into the local build.
